entry.title: 13.56MHZ RFID Field Strength Meter
entry.summary:
Vendor: Lab401
Type: RFID
Price: 80.00

Introduction

The 13.56MHz Field Strength Meter is a device that allows for quantitative measurement of 13.56MHz RF Fields. When placed in an active 13.56MHz field, an indicator LED shows the measurement result. LEDs are colour-coded for rapid visual confirmation of ISO standard compliance.

The device is entirely passive - it is powered by RFID field itself. Each Field Strength Meter has been tested and calibrated in accordance to ISO 14443 and ISO 15683 standards using an ISO 10373-7 testing framework, ensuring accurate measurements.

  • 2
  • 3
  • 4

1. ISO CALIBRATED

Each reader is ISO calibrated allowing to accurately test devices for compliance with ISO 14443 and ISO 15693 standards.

2. ENTIRELY PASSIVE

No batteries required, no charging required, no software required. The device is powered via the RFID field itself.

3. ISO Standard Size

ISO 7810 compliant dimensions: accurately test of readers calibrated for standard card sizes.

4. Ultra portable, ultra-durable

Built to last - no moving parts, no batteries. Each device is delivered in a protective case.

Technical Specifications

  • Size: 86.0 x 54.0 mm (ISO 7810)
  • Weight: 10g
  • Frequency: 13.56MHz
  • Indicators: 15 LEDs (including ISO 14443 & 15693 specification ranges)

What's included

  • 1x 13.56MHz Field Strength Meter
  • 1x Plastic Protective Case

entry.title: RFID Field Detector Ultra - LF/HF/UHF
entry.summary:
Vendor: Lab401
Type:
Price: 24.95

Introduction

The RFID Field Detector is a device that allows you to rapidily detect the presence of RFID Fields, and identify RFID which frequency is used.
Lab401's RFID Field Detector is the world's first triple-band detector - working with LF (125KHz), HF (13.56MHz) and UHF (860MHz).

Small enough to fit onto your keyring, and durable enough to survive: the RFID Field Detector is perfect for pentesters who need to rapidly perform access control reconnaissance, and indispensible for developers and RFID enthusiasts, allowing quick testing and identification of different RFID types.

The device is entirely passive - no batteries to recharge, no firmware to update, no switches to break. Simple place it on an RFID reader, and when an RFID field is detected, an LED indicates the frequency of the field.

  • 1
  • 2
  • 3
  • 4

1. Detect all RFID readers and signals

World's first tri-band RFID detector, featuring detection across the full UHF frequency range: 860 - 960MHz

2. Always ready, no batteries required

The RF Field Detector is completely passive - no batteries required, no charging required, no software required. The device uses wireless power from the RFID field to power itself.

3. Simultaneous multi-frequency detection

Features dual & tri-band simultaneous detection. If your target reader is multi-frequency, you'll know instantly.

4. Ultra portable, ultra-durable

Fits perfectly on your keyring with the included keyring loop, completely protected from bumps and shocks with its high-quality industrial-grade epoxy finish

Hands on with the RFID Detector Ultra

Get hands-on with Lab401's RFID Field Detector Ultra and see how it can be used to detect all types of RFID readers and fields and readers: LF, HF and UHF - without guessing and without batteries.

Technical Specifications

  • Size: 42 x 32 x 3 mm
  • Weight: 10g
Supported Frequencies
  • Low Frequency (125KHz) : Red LED
  • High Frequency (13.56MHz) : Green LED
  • Ultra High Frequency (860-960MHz) : Blue LED
